goal: Abuse protection (D1, Spec02 API-14): one client sending ~50 req/s from a single IP is throttled with 429 — the cache absorbs load, but only the rate limiter stops abuse. Run alone (profile 'abuse'): the verdict needs the per-status counts.
precondition: Rate limiter enabled with its default (production-like) budget.
_doc: Input requests. Locust loads this file, binds {{tokens}}, sends each request, then checks it against expectedFile.

cases.goal: Burst from ONE client IP on the hot availability query → first requests 200, then 429 with Retry-After and a ProblemDetail body. Never 5xx, never a hang.
